title: Event envelope
description: The shape every event travels in. Each event type's own schema narrows it: which type, version and source, whether tenant_id and outlet_id are required, and what data holds.

id.description: Unique for ever. Receivers store an event once per id, which is what makes repeats harmless.

version.description: New optional fields keep the version. Renamed or removed fields make a new one, and the sender emits both until every receiver has moved.

seq.description: The sender's own running order. Gaps are normal: a receiver is only sent the types it subscribes to.
